descriptionChirho: The Hebrew proper name Elijah (אֵלִיָּה / אֵלִיָּהוּ, meaning 'my God is YHWH'), the prominent prophet from Tishbe in Gilead who confronted Baal worship and was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind (1 Kings 17-2 Kings 2). All 71 occurrences denote the same individual across grammatical contexts: nominative (eng: Elijah/Eliyahu, spa: Elías, arb: إيلِيّا, hin: एलिय्याहू, kor: 엘리야, swa: Eliya), with conjunction 'and Elijah' (arb: وَ–إِيلِيَّا, hin: और–एलिय्याह), and with preposition min 'from Elijah' (arb: مِنْ–إِيلِيَا, swa: kutoka–kwa–Eliya). These represent purely syntactic variation.
